title: The settings merge preserves unrelated content, refuses invalid input, and is byte-stable
statement: Merging Kiln's owned fields into a `.pi/settings.json` that carries third-party packages, unrelated keys and a custom key order preserves every unrelated key and package entry and does not reorder existing keys. A file that is not valid JSON, whose root is not an object, or whose Kiln-owned fields hold invalid values is refused before anything is written, and the file is left byte-identical; unknown Pi and third-party fields are preserved rather than refused. Applying the same desired state again changes no bytes and does not change the file's modification time.
